question: Which leader founded the Servants of India Society to train Indians for national service and political awareness?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gopal Krishna Gokhale**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gopal Krishna Gokhale** founded the **Servants of India Society** in **1905** in Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• The society was established with the aim to **train Indians for national service** and create political awareness among the masses during the British colonial rule.
 
• Gopal Krishna Gokhale was a prominent **Indian political leader** and a social reformer who was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress.</l
